summary: Local fallback + deferred sync — global KB online ⇒ normal; offline ⇒ local fallback that never blocks tasks; restore ⇒ dedup-safe sync that never overwrites newer knowledge
implementation: electron/tenx/knowledge-sync.ts: TenxKnowledgeSync — contribute() chooses normal mode (gateway online) or local-fallback (records locally with full provenance + enqueues pending sync item, never blocking the caller); sync() drains pending against a gateway snapshot with an identity+version rule (never overwrite a target that is newer/same-id newer version) and a content-dedup rule (identical content contributes once, local redundant copy superseded); durable pending queue survives restart
tests: tests/unit/tenx-phase-10j.test.ts (6 tests): normal-mode push-through; offline local fallback queues + locally usable + provenance preserved + remote untouched; deferred sync pushes on restore; sync dedup (identical content on target ⇒ contributes once, no double push); never overwrites newer target (local v1 vs target v2 ⇒ skippedNewer, target stays v2); durable pending queue survives restart
notes: Syncing is deterministic and injectable (FakeGateway); no real network needed. Local fallback never blocks main tasks.
